issues.title: agent.run's resolved state type keeps the idle arm, so final.run.runId does not typecheck
issues.summary: agent.run's resolved type kept the never-started idle arm; run now resolves a narrowed DefinedAgentResolvedState (types only).

issues.title: A Cmd.define handler's ctx is never when the machine ctx is undefined
issues.summary: A ctx: undefined machine gave handlers a ctx of never; one HandlerCtx helper maps it to unknown (types only).

issues.title: No durable way for one agent to hand off to, or await, another agent
issues.summary: No durable sub-agent; adds agentTool, which runs a child agent keyed by the parent call and resumes it after a kill.

issues.title: Pattern docs still say a Cmd handler returns Promise<M | void>
issues.summary: Pattern docs and two comments still said Promise<M | void>; they now name the list form and migrate's refusal.

issues.title: agentEvents re-emits the previous step's events for a host that embeds the agent reducer
issues.summary: An embedding host re-projected old agent events; the projector skips outbox arrays it already saw, plus agentTool content tests.

issues.title: code-graph's published default rules name ‹product›'s own functions and SDKs
issues.summary: Default node-kind rules named one consumer's functions; defaults narrowed to generic names and pinned by a snapshot test.

issues.title: otel span-timing test fails under the full suite, passes alone
issues.summary: A flaky otel timing test was a real bug: span times now go from epoch ms to HrTime in one helper.

issues.title: code-graph --boundaries ignores imports from code outside every declared feature
issues.summary: --boundaries skipped importers outside every feature; new rule B4 flags them reaching past a feature's index.

issues.title: code-graph --data drops binding sites in anonymous callbacks at module scope, with no count
issues.summary: --data dropped module-scope callback sites and merged same-line calls; adds an unattributed list and a column key.

issues.title: code-graph --data alias scope leaks between sibling anonymous callbacks
issues.summary: --data aliases leaked across sibling callbacks; a lexical alias scope chain replaces one flat map.

issues.title: structure-sweep index exports inventory internals: glob helpers, zod input schemas, lever constants
issues.summary: structure-sweep's index exported inventory internals; it now exports only the two entry points and their types.

issues.title: Jev HTTP errors can echo the API key and drop the account error message
issues.summary: Jev client errors could carry the API key; both sweep clients redact error bodies and show the provider's account message.

issues.title: SplitCandidate doc comment still states the old refine cohesion definition
issues.summary: One doc comment kept the old cohesion definition; the comment is rewritten, nothing else.

issues.title: Layer patterns can't claim a file by its filename role, only by path prefix
issues.summary: --layers patterns could not match by file name; adds ** and in-segment *, a three-key specificity order and a tie refusal.

issues.title: code-graph's wrangler config loader counts a config with a mid-file syntax error as parsed
issues.summary: The wrangler loader repaired configs with syntax errors; it now reads them as wrangler does and lists any error as unparsed.

issues.title: code-graph --env-keys never names a wrangler config it could not parse
issues.summary: --env-keys ignored unparsed configs; it now lists them and withholds the reads under them with a new reason.

issues.title: tea README links point at /docs, which moved to packages/tea/docs
issues.summary: Eight README links pointed at a moved docs folder; links fixed and the link gate now checks this repo's URLs.

issues.title: code-graph readAllowance refuses a driving adapter whose read decides nothing
issues.summary: readAllowance needed a decidedBy library even for reads that decide nothing; decidedBy is now optional.

issues.title: A child stopped with run.stop() stays in the host's table under tea's spawn helper
issues.summary: run.stop() left a child in the host's table; adds a stop helper to ./effect and docs that state the limit.

issues.title: A failing notify under tea's spawn helper is seen by nobody
issues.summary: A failing notify under spawn was lost; notify is now typed so it cannot fail, and the host handles the error.

issues.title: tea's child machine helpers are linked from the how-to index only
issues.summary: The child helpers how-to was linked from one page; the README, the Effect how-to and the glossary now link it.

issues.title: createJevAsk cannot name its Cmd, so two Jev knobs in one machine collide
issues.summary: createJevAsk could not name its Cmd; adds an optional name threaded through the Cmd and Msg types.

issues.title: run-many-machines step 3 uses Scope and Exit values that step 2 does not import
issues.summary: A how-to step used Scope and Exit without importing them; the step gets its imports and the page joins the typecheck test.
